info.title: Cityside Application APIs
info.description: Integrated application APIs for the six service backends. Documents the PROVIDER_INTEGRATION=true surface, where every route except /health requires a Keycloak bearer token. Each operation lists its own service port in servers.

bearerAuth.description: Keycloak-issued RS256 access token with typ Bearer, an audience that includes KEYCLOAK_AUDIENCE (default agent-core), the superapp-user realm role, and a non-service-account subject.

XAccountId.name: X-Account-Id
XAccountId.description: Account to act on. Defaults to the signed-in user personal account. Must be owned by the user.

XRequestId.name: X-Request-Id
XRequestId.description: Caller correlation ID, truncated to 200 characters.

403.description: X-Account-Id is not owned by the signed-in user (ACCOUNT_FORBIDDEN), or eligibility enforcement restricts the account (ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED).

429.description: Concurrency, rate or key capacity limit reached.

503.description: Provider or eligibility service unavailable (PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, ELIGIBILITY_UNAVAILABLE or REQUEST_FAILED).
